service.ur: رہائشی اجازت نامے کے ڈیٹا میں ترمیم

about: Change details on an existing residence permit, such as the profession.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For residents, foreign students via their institution, and employees via their employer
Application is cancelled if requested changes are not completed in time
documents: Work card if the profession changes
Government letter for the government sector
fees: Emirates ID replacement to show new details 150 AED
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
